notes.title: Release News and сute bonus
notes.content:
[p]We will release an update ActII in June with 99% certainty (in Steam, release in itc a couple of weeks after the release in Steam! (it's very possible that it's already June 19th!)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GtgKSY2XMAAseF7?format=jpg&name=large"][/img][/p][p][b]сute bonus![/b][/p][p]Perhaps many people remember the instructions for reviving the handsome prince from the game![/p][p]The instructions are a bit controversial, therefore, we will provide our list of how to please Bastie! (it's a joke, of course, but every joke has a bit of a joke, hehe)[/p][p]So, how to please Bastie: 
1. Cover him with a blanket when he sleeps (almost always) 
2. To enclose his body with tape so that no one steps on Bastie 
3. Present him blackout curtains 
4. Present him a big cuddle pillow 
5. Be a cuddle pillow 
6. Sing a lullaby 
7. Put all glasses of water away[/p]
